primary.raw_signal: column5 finite nonnegative numeric; >0 detection; zero-valued recorded sites still participate in geometric ambiguity
primary.boundary: inclusive, all exact raw member TSS; not representative-only
primary.pooling: sum technical counts per exact coordinate/strand within each fixed biosample; retain union of sites including recorded zeros
primary.target: at least one supported compatible site in each biological pool, BOTH2/2; positions can differ
primary.ties: include all exact boundary ties; actual selected fraction and scoring coverage reported
primary.interpretation: promoter CTSS support event, not transcript function or functional probability

eligibility.predictions_frozen_for: ALL structurally legal non-global/non-exposure groups with complete common10 measurement, including eventual assay-ineligible groups
eligibility.realized_mask: computed by independent extractor AFTER prediction freeze; not falsely called label-blind precomputed eligibility
eligibility.contig_presence: must appear in recorded CTSS rows in BOTH biological pools; same original assay semantics; pooled union of technical library contigs
eligibility.structural: valid strand, nonempty all-member TSS, original technical eligibility, all frozen global/exposure exclusions applied
eligibility.mapping_shared: each recorded CTSS coordinate hits>=2 legal promoter groups within100; zero-signal rows included
eligibility.unresolved_exclusion: ALL_COMPATIBLE_CTSS_PROMOTER_GROUP_SHARED iff group has>=1 shared-compatible observation and no uniquely mapped observation within100; exclude entire such group regardless primary positivity
eligibility.negative: assay-eligible not reproducibly detected, not biological absence

sensitivities.secondary_position_concordant_5bp: within primary50 windows, any supported coordinate pair across two biosamples distance<=5; subset of primary by construction

dependence.pre_outcome_component: merge compatible genes, frozen genomic blocks, shared junctions/reads when available, and same-strand all-member TSS proximity<=200bp covering ambiguity +/-100 sharing; this changes only external bootstrap graph, not promoter definition or historic HepG2 folds
dependence.post_unlock_check: every actual shared CTSS link within100 must lie within pre-frozen component, else STOP without silently adding outcome-dependent edges
dependence.bootstrap: 2000 paired component-resampling draws, retain all group multiplicities within each sampled component; not bootstrap four libraries or claim components are biological replicates
dependence.paired_scoring_support: identical eligible finite-score groups for each contrast; no fill-low score

interpretation: cross-system locus overlap reported, not automatic new-gene generalization
historical final remains exposed; no old final reuse
2/2 and HepG2 2/3 enrichment not assumed same absolute measurement scale

required: independently accepted candidate declaration-level provenance with runtime limitation
complete P1 inputs and frozen preprocessing/training protocol
ALL external predictions frozen and independent fit-disabled replay
precise CTSS download manifest/checksum-or-official-version metadata recorded
